name: New Issue

overview.en: [excited] Let's report a new Issue! Think of this... as logging a problem — like missing linen or quality defects. [friendly] It dynamically changes depending on if the source is a Customer or a Laundry vendor. Let's walk through it!
overview.hi: [excited] चलिए एक नई Issue report करते हैं! इसे... एक problem log करने की तरह सोचिए — जैसे missing linen या quality defects। [friendly] यह dynamically बदलता है इस बात पर निर्भर करके कि source एक Customer है या Laundry vendor। चलते हैं!

explanation.en: [casual] When did this happen? Just pick the date.
explanation.hi: [casual] यह कब हुआ? बस date चुनें।

explanation.en: [curious] Who is this about? A CUSTOMER hotel or a LAUNDRY vendor? This choice changes what happens next!
explanation.hi: [curious] यह किसके बारे में है? एक CUSTOMER hotel या LAUNDRY vendor? यह choice आगे क्या होता है वो बदल देती है!

full.en: [curious] Who is this about? A CUSTOMER hotel or a LAUNDRY vendor? This choice changes the Source Name and Trigger Entity.
full.hi: [curious] यह किसके बारे में है? एक CUSTOMER hotel या LAUNDRY vendor? यह choice Source Name और Trigger Entity को बदल देती है।

explanation.en: [casual] Search and pick the exact Customer or Vendor.
explanation.hi: [casual] सही Customer या Vendor को search करके चुनें।

full.en: [casual] Search and pick the exact Customer or Vendor involved.
full.hi: [casual] involved Customer या Vendor को search करके चुनें।

CUSTOMER.en: [casual] Let's pick the customer hotel... Arama Suites.
CUSTOMER.hi: [casual] चलिए customer hotel चुनते हैं... Arama Suites।

LAUNDRY.en: [casual] Let's pick the laundry vendor... LinenCare Services.
LAUNDRY.hi: [casual] चलिए laundry vendor चुनते हैं... LinenCare Services।

explanation.en: [casual] What triggered this? An ORDER or a WASH FULFILLMENT?
explanation.hi: [casual] यह किससे trigger हुआ? एक ORDER से या WASH FULFILLMENT से?

full.en: [casual] What triggered this? An ORDER or a WASH FULFILLMENT?
full.hi: [casual] यह किससे trigger हुआ? एक ORDER से या WASH FULFILLMENT से?

CUSTOMER.en: [curious] Notice it auto-changed to ORDER for the customer!
CUSTOMER.hi: [curious] देखिए, customer के लिए यह automatically ORDER में बदल गया!

LAUNDRY.en: [curious] Notice it auto-changed to WASH_FULFILLMENT for the laundry!
LAUNDRY.hi: [curious] देखिए, laundry के लिए यह automatically WASH_FULFILLMENT में बदल गया!

explanation.en: [casual] Pick the Order Date. This loads their orders for that day.
explanation.hi: [casual] Order Date चुनें। यह उस दिन के orders load कर देता है।

full.en: [casual] Pick the Order Date. This automatically loads their orders for that day.
full.hi: [casual] Order Date चुनें। यह automatically उस दिन के उनके orders load कर देता है।

nodes.label: Orders
nodes.emptyMessage: No orders found for this selection. You can still continue without linking one.

explanation.en: [casual] Link a specific order... if there is one.
explanation.hi: [casual] किसी specific order से link करें... अगर कोई हो तो।

explanation.en: [casual] Pick the Wash Date to link this to laundry processing.
explanation.hi: [casual] Wash Date चुनें ताकि इसे laundry processing से link किया जा सके।

full.en: [casual] Pick the Wash Date to link this issue with laundry processing on that day.
full.hi: [casual] Wash Date चुनें ताकि इस issue को उस दिन की laundry processing से link किया जा सके।

explanation.en: [curious] What's the category? Missing items, quality defects... pick one.
explanation.hi: [curious] category क्या है? Missing items, quality defects... एक चुनें।

explanation.en: [casual] What's the initial status? Usually OPEN.
explanation.hi: [casual] initial status क्या है? आमतौर पर OPEN होता है।

explanation.en: [casual] Give us the details. What EXACTLY happened?
[casual] Which product is affected? This is optional, but helpful.
explanation.hi: [casual] कौन सा product affected है? यह optional है, लेकिन helpful है।

explanation.en: [casual] How many items were affected? Just the number.
explanation.hi: [casual] कितने items affected हुए? बस number डालें।

wrapUp.en: [warm and satisfied] And that's all for reporting this issue! [friendly] We've logged all the details. Nothing was saved... but whenever you are ready, go report a REAL issue. You've got this!
wrapUp.hi: [warm and satisfied] और इस issue को report करने के लिए बस इतना ही! [friendly] हमने सारी details log कर ली हैं। कुछ भी save नहीं हुआ... लेकिन जब भी तैयार हों, जाइए और एक REAL issue report करें। आप यह कर सकते हैं!

description: Walkthrough for creating a new issue in the issue tracker
